{"consolidated_memory":"BROKEN LAYOUT IN EMAIL RENDERER - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)
Shared symptom across both: table overflows in the plain text part when rendering digest template with a long subject
Test coverage: tests/notifications/test_render.py

INCIDENT 1 [2026-04-25]
Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
Trigger condition: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
PR #6026 on branch fix/broken-layout-1
Measured outcome: reclaimed 73 GB of blob storage
Stack: Python

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-03]
Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Trigger condition: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
PR #8375 on branch fix/broken-layout-2
Measured outcome: job finished in 28 minutes instead of 9 hours
Stack: Python

These represent distinct problems with the same symptom, suggesting either a regression pattern or multiple underlying issues that produce similar visual failures in the email renderer."}
